A `$state` that an `$effect` only sets from other values is a `$derived` that can also be assigned, which Svelte has since 5.25. The suggestion makes it one and removes the effect. The rule looks at components in runes mode and at `.svelte.js` and `.svelte.ts` files.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/prefer-writable-derived": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script>
  function search(query) {
    let term = $state(query);
    $effect(() => {
      term = query;
    });
    return term;
  }
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script>
  function search(query) {
    let term = $derived(query);
    return term;
  }
</script>
```
